g.text: Presence: JP_GND_DET_T/B/R are BONDED to tile GND (inserted = hard ground on the contact, removed = open); the backplane keeps the three detect traces separate (connector-next owns them).

g.desc: Presence: JP_GND_DET_T/B/R are BONDED to tile GND (inserted = hard ground on the contact, removed = open); the backplane keeps the three detect traces separate (connector-next owns them).

g.text: Rails: VCC 3.3 V from chassis (JP_VCC power_out feeds the tile); VCC1V2 1.2 V locally regulated by U2=TI TLV75512PDBVR (SBVS320D: CIN>=1u C9, COUT>=1u C8 BEFORE bead FB1; core caps C4/C5/C6 sit on the filtered side). Accuracy 1.188-1.212 V within 1.07-1.26 V spec.

g.desc: Rails: VCC 3.3 V from chassis (JP_VCC power_out feeds the tile); VCC1V2 1.2 V locally regulated by U2=TI TLV75512PDBVR (SBVS320D: CIN>=1u C9, COUT>=1u C8 BEFORE bead FB1; core caps C4/C5/C6 sit on the filtered side). Accuracy 1.188-1.212 V within 1.07-1.26 V spec.

g.text: FPGA: Gowin GW1NZ-LV1QN48C6/I5 (QN48 6x6 P0.4). Config: MODE[2:0]='000 AUTO BOOT from embedded flash (UG290); JTAG live on TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO test pads; 26 tile IO per production cst; unused pads 6/9/14/15/29 (pin 9 = UG842/UG846 order-code hazard).
